study_identification_part.si_4_title: Lifespan Normative Models of White Matter Fractional Anisotropy: Applications to Early Psychosis

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Five cohorts (HCP-B, HCP-D, HCP-YA, HCP-A, and UK Biobank) were used for normative model construction (total N=24,915). The HCP-EP dataset (N=173) was used for clinical application.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: First, we assembled high-quality multi-shell diffusion data from five cohorts having closely matched acquisition and processing pipelines, namely Human Connectome Project (HCP) Baby [20], HCP Development [21], HCP Young Adult [22], HCP Aging [23] datasets, and UK Biobank [24]. ... we applied these reference models to the HCP early psychosis (HCP-EP) dataset (N=173 with diffusion data ...)

answer.HCP-EP: clinical application (patient for clinical research and transfer sets for calibration)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCP-B, HCP-D, HCP-YA, HCP-A, and UKB were pooled and split into equal training and test sets (N=12,457 each) for the lifespan normative model. HCP-EP (N=173, comprising 118 patients and 55 controls) was used to derive z-scores and map symptoms, with half of the controls used for transfer learning calibration.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Total N=24,915, (N=12,457 for training and N=12,457 for test, stratified for sex, self-reported race, dataset and site). ... we applied these reference models to the HCP early psychosis (HCP-EP) dataset ... Next, we divided this dataset into a training set, consisting of half of the control participants, and combined it with the larger training set described above to retrain the normative models ...

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The total dataset of 24,915 healthy individuals was split into a training set (N=12,457) and a test set (N=12,457) to develop and validate the normative models across 48 white matter tracts.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Total N=24,915, (N=12,457 for training and N=12,457 for test, stratified for sex, self-reported race, dataset and site). ... A normative model was then fit to the training set for each white matter tract.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The lifespan model covered ages from 0 to 100 years. Specific cohort ranges: HCP-B (0.04-3), HCP-D (8-22), HCP-YA (22-37), HCP-A (36-100), UKB (46-82). Combined mean and SD were not explicitly reported in the text or tables.
